272
echo "== 1. 送达 v1.2 并语法检查 =="
echo  | base64 -d > /root/azar_guard.sh.v12
bash -n /root/azar_guard.sh.v12 && echo 语法OK
echo ""
echo "== 2. 与旧版差异摘要 =="
diff /root/azar_guard.sh /root/azar_guard.sh.v12 | head -30
echo ""
echo "== 3. 备份并替换 =="
cp /root/azar_guard.sh /root/azar_guard.sh.bak_v11_1108
mv /root/azar_guard.sh.v12 /root/azar_guard.sh
echo 替换完成
echo ""
echo "== 4. 重启守护进程 ="
pkill -f "azar_[g]uard"; sleep 1
cd /root && setsid nohup bash /root/azar_guard.sh >> /root/guard_run.log 2>&1 &
sleep 2
pgrep -af "azar_[g]uard" && echo 守护已重启
echo ""
echo "== 5. 重启NapCat使bypass生效并出新码 =="
pkill -f "opt/QQ/[q]q"; sleep 2
cd /root/Napcat && setsid nohup xvfb-run -a /root/Napcat/opt/QQ/qq --no-sandbox --disable-gpu --disable-software-rasterizer --disable-dev-shm-usage --js-flags=--max-old-space-size=512 > /root/napcat.log 2>&1 < /dev/null &
sleep 25
cp /root/Napcat/opt/QQ/resources/app/app_launcher/napcat/cache/qrcode.png /sdcard/DCIM/Camera/asar_qr.png && echo 新码已放进相册
echo ""
echo "== 6. NapCat 版本与启动日志头 =="
head -30 /root/napcat.log | grep -aiE "napcat|version|启动" | head -8
date "+完成时间: %H:%M:%S"
